user_anchor.status: User confirmed the viewport centre. Do not silently rewrite this as confirmation of only a horizontal coordinate or silently move the anchor.

cross: A small dark brown/black Latin crucifix silhouette between two tall windows, on the painted upper wall.
Its horizontal arm is near the upper quarter of its total height, not at the vertical centre.
The image is insufficient for a faithful carved/sculpted figure or fine fixing details; do not invent those details.
It is closer to the left window than to the right window in the 2023 view, not at the midpoint of the gap.
windows: At least two complete tall window bays are visible, one on either side of the cross.
Each has approximately two primary columns and three primary horizontal zones.
The lower zone is taller than the middle or upper zone; equal thirds would not closely follow the visible outer frames.
Each upper-left portion contains a window air-conditioner with horizontal grille. The other upper part is translucent/clear glazing with fine vertical bars.
Middle and lower portions contain additional thinner glazing bars. Details and opening operation cannot be recovered reliably from this image.
A partly occluded additional window fragment to the left does not establish the whole W-wall bay count.

approximate_image_measurements_not_recti.notice: Hand-read native-image coordinates, approximately several pixels uncertainty. These are image-plane ratios, not metric measurements or a camera-calibrated reconstruction.
approximate_image_measurements_not_recti.perspective_limit: The right window appears wider than the left; direct horizontal ratios should not be treated as rectified world distances.

height_conflict.conflict: The confirmed ray falls within/below the model mosaic band, whereas both source photographs place the complete cross above the cap.
height_conflict.additional_geometric_check: If a roughly 2.2 m tall window is used with the observed cross/window vertical ratio, putting its cross centre at h1.673 would make the window top about h2.19 and its bottom approximately h-0.01. This is inconsistent with the photographed raised window sill.
not_safe: Do not silently move the cross up and label its full 3D point user-confirmed.
Do not lower the whole dado or shrink the two tall windows just to force them around the low ray.
Do not claim simultaneous exact correspondence to the user ray and the photo proportions.

implementation_choices.strict_full_anchor: Retain the full confirmed point. If placing a cross there, explicitly document the photo-height conflict and do not call the paired-window reconstruction photo-accurate. A reversible local asset can be prepared without adjusting the existing wall cap.
implementation_choices.photo_height_interpretation: If the primary agent decides the user's goal and conversational intent support treating centre as a horizontal placement cue, state that interpretation clearly to the user before applying it; retain v17.599447 and derive vertical placement above the cap from the photo. This is an inference, not explicit confirmation of the adjusted 3D point.

illustrative_photo_proportions_only.warning: The following is a rendering starting point only, not a verified site window schedule or placement instruction.
illustrative_photo_proportions_only.basis: Fits the observed local ratios and keeps the cross above the current cap. Absolute metric sizes and precise v offsets remain unmeasured.

ceiling_and_floor_boundary: This user anchor and the two windows do not determine interior column positions, beam spans, black floor-band widths or the rest of the window wall. Do not derive a full structural grid from this local group.
